description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - The Colombo Port City (Offshore Banking - Preliminary) Regulation No.04 of 2024.
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. It establishes legal and regulatory frameworks for offshore banking operations within the Colombo Port City, including licensing requirements, capital requirements, and operational guidelines. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves "new laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." While it mentions the Minister's name, it does not focus on personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, and the primary content is regulatory in nature.
